description: Reusable authored-pose direction for warrior player identities. Identity details always come from player-variants.json and the staged portrait; this profile supplies only class motion and continuity rules.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: grounded, weighted, disciplined, vigilant, and powerful, with committed footwork and readable weapon-and-shield body mechanics
identity.equipmentRule: Keep the authoritative portrait's armor, weapon, shield, and accessory designs and count consistent in every pose. When the portrait contains a sword and shield, show exactly one of each, keep them in the correct hands, and never duplicate, swap, sheathe, or transform them.
identity.magicRule: Warrior motion is physical rather than spell-casting. Do not add magical projectiles, runes, halos, or aura; if the identity portrait explicitly establishes a small enchanted accent, preserve its exact palette and keep it secondary to the martial action.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is the approved full-body pixel-art style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} that faithfully preserves Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, hair, eyes, complexion, armor, costume, palette, proportions, and martial equipment. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into the compact full-body quality and readable armored silhouette demonstrated by Image 2. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery. Use a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding on every side. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp intentional pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment color ramps. One centered full-body warrior in a guarded neutral ready stance facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right and then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall warrior motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve the exact portrait identity, armor, costume, palette, proportions, and equipment throughout. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters between complete head-to-toe poses. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: A vigilant breathing loop with shield coverage, a ready weapon, and alternating armored weight shifts; the first and last poses connect smoothly.
idle.effectRule: No attack trail or active magic; only subtle cloth, hair, and armor-settling motion.
frameDescriptions: guarded ready stance with shield forward and sword poised
measured inhale with chest raised and shield hand firm
weight shift onto the forward leg with knees flexed
alert weapon lift while the shield continues covering the torso
centered guarded midpoint
measured exhale with shoulders lowering and armor settling
weight shift onto the rear leg with a distinct shield angle
guarded stance flowing smoothly back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: A steadfast shield-led march with alternating contacts, real knee compression, passing poses, controlled weapon counter-motion, and weighted armor follow-through.
walk.effectRule: No attack effect or active magic; armor, straps, hair, and cloth respond naturally to each planted step.
frameDescriptions: left foot forward contact with shield leading
left leg compressed under armored weight
passing pose with right knee advancing and sword balancing behind
right foot reaching forward while shield protects the chest
right foot forward contact with a firm heel plant
right leg compressed under armored weight
passing pose with left knee advancing and sword counter-moving
left foot reaching forward into the marching loop

attack.motionDirection: A planted martial strike with shield-led anticipation, deep sword windup, committed stepping slash, decisive contact, full-body follow-through, recoil, and guarded recovery.
attack.effectRule: A short physical blade-swish accent may appear only near contact; no projectile or magical blast, and the accent must not obscure the sword arm, shield, or footing.

shield presses outward as the sword arm draws back
deep sword windup with hips and shoulders coiled over the rear leg
committed forward step beginning a diagonal slash
full sword strike at contact with shield still guarding
powerful follow-through with torso rotation and rear foot driving
weapon recoil while the shield closes the opening
recovered guarded ready stance

hurt.motionDirection: A heavy articulated hit breaks the guard into a maximum stagger, forced backward step, shield brace, defiant rise, and disciplined recovery without losing either item.
hurt.effectRule: Use only a compact physical impact accent at the struck edge of the guard; no gore, blood, full-body tint, or magical ward.
frameDescriptions: guarded ready stance before impact
sharp impact flinch with shield knocked inward
maximum stagger with torso twisted and sword arm thrown wide
forced backward step with deeply bent knees
low shield brace that arrests the recoil
defiant push upright behind the shield
feet reset while sword and shield rebuild the guard
recovered guarded ready stance

death.motionDirection: A final impact breaks the guard, the planted stance fails, knees buckle, armor drops into a sideward collapse, the body reaches the ground, and motion settles into an unmistakable fully fallen rest pose.
death.effectRule: No gore, blood, dismemberment, or magic. Weapon and shield remain single, recognizable items through the grounded fall, and the body must never be a rigidly rotated upright sprite.
frameDescriptions: fatal impact breaks the guarded stance
shield drops and sword arm slackens as balance fails
both knees buckle under the armor
one knee grounds while the torso tips sideways
armored body and equipment descend into full ground contact
low fallen body settles with limbs clearly articulated
final fully fallen warrior pose with equipment at rest
same final fallen pose held

victory.motionDirection: The warrior confirms the win, rises from guard, stamps forward, raises the sword, presents the shield, delivers a proud weapon salute, opens into a broad heroic stance, and holds the triumphant finish.
victory.effectRule: No spell effect or projectile; a restrained metal glint may accent the raised weapon without hiding its silhouette.
